matching.gap_or_conflict: found when a finding (state gap or conflict; the strict score also needs the planted kind) is on the item's section and its FSD quote overlaps the planted sentence: one contains the other, or at least 60% of the quote's words are in it.
matching.undocumented: found when a finding with state undocumented is on one of the item's pages, or on the item's section, and (for a behaviour) one of its keywords is in the finding's page quote or note, case-insensitive.
matching.falseAlarm: a finding (gap, conflict or undocumented) that matches no planted item is unplanted; the hand check of a sample of 20 (fixed seed) says which are real drift.
matching.ranges: 95% ranges by resampling planted items, 1,000 resamples, seed 42.

items.text: Up to 10 series can be selected from the search results and added together in one step.
The episode list of a series can be exported as a CSV file.
Episodes can be dragged to another day to change their air date.
Each queue item has a priority (High, Normal or Low) that the user can change to reorder the downloads.
Any history entry can be undone, which restores the episode file that an upgrade replaced.
A weekly email digest lists every missing episode.
Each tag has a colour, chosen from a palette of 12 colours, which is shown wherever the tag appears.
Each quality can be limited to a maximum episode runtime.
The font size can be set to small, medium or large.
Backups can be copied automatically to an S3 bucket.
Deleting a series always deletes its folder and all its files from disk.
items.code: deleting files is an option, off by default (DeleteSeriesModalContent)

items.text: Sonarr can share the calendar as an iCal feed, which covers the previous 14 days and the next 60 days.
Removing an item from the queue always adds the release to the blocklist.
Search All starts straight away, without asking the user to confirm.
Tag labels may contain letters, numbers, spaces and underscores.
Deleting a tag removes it from every series, profile and indexer that uses it.
items.code: a tag in use can't be deleted (TagService.Delete)

items.text: The default delay profile can be given tags like any other.
items.code: the default profile must have no tags (DelayProfileController)

items.text: Each log file can grow up to 50 megabytes before a new one is started.
Interval: how often an automatic backup is taken, from 1 to 30 days.
Retention: how long backups are kept, up to 365 days.

scopeNote: fsd.scope for the run: the areas the FSD's introduction says it covers (library, calendar, activity, wanted, settings, system), as route prefixes. Not the planted screens: every screen in those areas that no section links to is listed by code.
